producer.name: Oya Takashi Shuzo
producer.about: Oya Takashi Shuzo is a sake brewery in Aikawa, in northwest Kanagawa, founded in 1830. Its origin goes back to the first Oya, a cavalry captain on the Hojo side at the 1569 Battle of Mimasetoge, who left the warrior's life after the battle and served as village head. Later the family took over a sake brewing licence from a brewer in Oiso and began making sake.
